string.text: Museum Piece
Every object in your collection belongs to a location, a patrol and a return story. Beyond the Perimeter they are curiosities; to you they are carefully preserved records of field work.
Marathoner
A movement starts with controlled breathing and ends only inside your own perimeter. You maintain pace under a pack and keep a reserve for the final sprint no plan can predict.
Hero

The trader remembers who brought the shipment through; the technician remembers who went back for a partner. Your record has entered local conversation, and people behind the counter take it into account.
Inner Pockets
Your kit has been reworked around your routine: nothing swings loose or catches during a change of position. Even the lining has room for equipment best kept close.
Neat Freak
After every patrol, you inspect seams, fastenings and component condition. Armour lasts because small wear is dealt with before it becomes a serious failure.
Noosphere Link
At some point, hunger and thirst stopped cutting through the quiet hum in your head. Rations remain in your rig out of habit, but your body draws what it needs from another source.

Some artefacts reveal their properties only to someone with the right training. You do not ask the Zone for an explanation. You test your equipment in the field and remember the result.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] On kill, repair equipped perk-based artefacts (%c[yellow]perkifacts%c[ui_gray_2]) by 3% divided by your total equipped perkifact count
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] Perkifact effects behave as if you are wearing %c[d_green]four additional copies
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] For instance, wearing 1 "Signet" acts as %c[d_green]5 "Signets"
 %c[d_red] - %c[ui_gray_2] Neither the "Knot" nor the "Lucifer" benefit from this perk
